mapper.select: SELECT pa.*, u.username as user_username, u.name as user_name FROM permission_application pa LEFT JOIN user u ON pa.user_id = u.id ORDER BY pa.apply_time DESC
SELECT pa.*, u.username as user_username, u.name as user_name FROM permission_application pa LEFT JOIN user u ON pa.user_id = u.id WHERE pa.id = #{id}
SELECT pa.*, u.username as user_username, u.name as user_name FROM permission_application pa LEFT JOIN user u ON pa.user_id = u.id WHERE pa.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY pa.apply_time DESC
SELECT pa.*, u.username as user_username, u.name as user_name FROM permission_application pa LEFT JOIN user u ON pa.user_id = u.id WHERE pa.status = #{status} ORDER BY pa.apply_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO permission_application(user_id, applicant_name, application_type, reason, status, apply_time) VALUES(#{userId}, #{applicantName}, #{applicationType}, #{reason}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE permission_application SET application_type = #{applicationType}, reason = #{reason}, status = #{status}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, reviewer_name = #{reviewerName}, review_comment = #{reviewComment}, review_time = #{reviewTime} WHERE id = #{id}
